reserves.name: Argentine-peso deposits at Argentine financial institutions

sources.label: Independent public accountant certification for wARS - June 2026

reserveReview.rationale: The June 30, 2026 certification reconciles 7,619,996,077 outstanding wARS across eight chains to ARS7,909,436,643.14 deposited in Argentine bank accounts and financial institutions and certifies full local-currency backing. Pablo Eduardo Soto signed the certification on July 28, 2026 for SLD y Asociados S.A. The engagement expressly does not constitute an audit or review and expresses no professional opinion. The institutions and account terms remain undisclosed. The official wFIAT attestation index serves this report as its latest wARS evidence on September 30, 2026; the 92-day-old balance date remains outside the live adapter's 33-day freshness ceiling.
